expectations.text: Defines both lenses: impact materiality (inside-out) and financial materiality (outside-in), with a topic material if it meets either
expectations.evidence: "impact materiality plus financial materiality, a topic is material if it meets either or both" with inside-out/outside-in steps 2-5

expectations.text: Describes the process: context/stakeholder mapping, identification of impacts/risks/opportunities, scoring with defined thresholds, validation and documentation
expectations.evidence: Eight-step process: "Understand the context" + value-chain map, stakeholder engagement, scoring "1 to 5... set and justify your thresholds", "Validate and update", "Document and disclose"

expectations.text: Connects DMA output to disclosure scope: material topics drive which topical standards and datapoints apply (ESRS 2 general disclosures always apply)
expectations.evidence: "the DMA matters more as the filter for topical disclosures. ESRS 2 general disclosures remain mandatory regardless of outcome"

expectations.text: Reflects the revised-ESRS simplification accurately (fewer mandatory datapoints; relief provisions) without claiming the DMA itself was abolished
expectations.evidence: "Mandatory datapoints fall from over 1,000 to roughly 320"; "What stays constant: double materiality... the DMA drives what you report"

expectations.text: Output is actionable: stepwise plan or table, with governance/audit-trail expectations for assurance readiness
expectations.evidence: Stepwise plan plus "keep decisions, scoring and stakeholder evidence traceable, and have the board or audit committee approve the outcome" (limited assurance, Art. 26a)
